statements.query: MATCH (:GCPPrincipal)-[r:ASSUME_ROLE]->(:GCPRole)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP GCPRole-to-Principal relationships that are out of date.

statements.query: MATCH (:GCPPrincipal)-[r:ASSUME_ROLE{project_id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID}]->(:GCPRole)-[:HAS_ACCESS_TO]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP GCPPrincipal-to-GCPRole relationships that are out of date.

statements.query: MATCH (:GCPRole)-[r:HAS_ACCESS_TO]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove GCP GCPRole-to-Project relationships that are out of date.

statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(org:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(project:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID}) MATCH (role:GCPRole)-[r:TRUSTS_GCP_PRINCIPAL{account_id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID}]->(:GCPExternalPrincipal) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG AND ((org)-[:RESOURCE]->(role) OR (project)-[:RESOURCE]->(role)) WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (r) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Remove this project's stale grants to external principals: one TRUSTS_GCP_PRINCIPAL edge per granting project (account_id), from an organization or project role of this tenant. The principal node is shared by every tenant that grants it, so only the edge goes here.

statements.query: MATCH (n:GCPExternalPrincipal) WHERE NOT (n)--() AND n.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE (n) return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
statements.__comment__: Orphan sweep, tenant-independent: delete an external principal once no tenant's role trusts it.
